output.narrative_summary: This result rests on the link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue. If that cost rises enough, more runs could support a different option. In this model, 41% of runs supported Self Serve Funnel.

story_headlines.opt_selfserve: Self Serve Funnel benefits from lower acquisition cost pressure in this model, supporting its modelled revenue outcome.
story_headlines.opt_paid: Paid Acquisition would need acquisition cost to behave more favourably in the model for more runs to support it.
story_headlines.opt_partner: Partner Channel's modelled outcome sits lower, needing stronger assumptions on New Revenue to draw more support.
story_headlines.opt_outbound: Outbound Sales shows the lowest modelled outcome range here, well below what would draw more runs its way.

robustness_explanation.summary: The ordering holds in about 64% of variations, a moderate but not overwhelming level of stability.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: The link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue is the main thing this result depends on.
stability_factors: Self Serve Funnel's modelled outcome range stays comparatively solid across variations
fragility_factors: The link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue could shift which option more runs support

output.readiness_rationale: This comparison is settled enough to act on, though Customer Acquisition Cost is the one factor worth firming up first given its weight in the result.

fac_cac.specific_action: Pull recent acquisition cost data by channel from internal reporting to confirm current levels before committing budget.
fac_cac.rationale: This factor's relationship to New Revenue is what the result most depends on.
fac_cac.decision_hygiene: Estimate current acquisition cost yourself before checking the actual figures.

flip_thresholds.narrative: If Customer Acquisition Cost moves from 420 GBP to 610 GBP, more runs would support a different option.

key_assumptions: The link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue assumes current market conditions hold through next quarter.
The comparison assumes each growth bet's modelled outcome range reflects realistic execution conditions.

decision_quality_prompts.question: Choosing Self Serve Funnel, what does giving up Paid Acquisition cost?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: Four options are being compared for the same budget, so what is foregone is worth naming explicitly.

decision_quality_prompts.question: What would make you switch to Paid Acquisition?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: Self Serve Funnel is comparatively well supported here, so it is worth stress testing against the next most viable option.

pre_mortem.failure_scenario: Budget went to Self Serve Funnel but Customer Acquisition Cost rose well beyond current levels, eroding the New Revenue outcome the model expected.
warning_signs: Acquisition cost climbing steadily above current levels
New Revenue growth falling short of modelled expectations early in the quarter
pre_mortem.mitigation: Set a checkpoint to review actual acquisition cost against the modelled level partway through the quarter.
pre_mortem.review_trigger: Reconvene if acquisition cost trends toward the higher end of modelled range before quarter close.
